Subject: Regarding Your Recent Report - Phone Issue

Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to us. We're very sorry to hear that your phone is broken, and we understand how frustrating that can be.

To help us understand the situation better and assist you as quickly as possible, could you please provide us with a few more details? Specifically, it would be very helpful if you could tell us:

1.  **What model of phone is it?** (e.g., iPhone 13, Samsung Galaxy S22, etc.)
2.  **When did you purchase the phone?** (An approximate date is fine if you don't have the exact one)
3.  **Can you describe what happened when it broke?** (e.g., dropped it, stopped working suddenly, screen cracked, won't turn on, water damage, etc.)
4.  **Do you have any warranty or protection plans associated with the device?**

Once we have this information, we'll be able to guide you through the next steps, which may include troubleshooting, repair options, or potential replacement under warranty.

Please reply to this email with the details requested. Alternatively, if you prefer to speak with someone, you can call our support team at [Your Phone Number] during our business hours of [Business Hours, e.g., Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 5 PM EST].

We look forward to helping you resolve this issue promptly.

Sincerely,

The [Your Company Name] Support Team

Subject: Regarding Your Recent Phone Issue - How Can We Help?

Dear Valued Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We're very sorry to hear that your phone has broken, and we understand how frustrating and disruptive this can be. Please accept our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience this has caused.

To help us assist you best and find the quickest resolution, could you please provide us with a few more details? Specifically, it would be very helpful if you could tell us:

*   What is the **model of your phone**?
*   When did you **purchase it**? (This helps us check warranty status)
*   Could you please describe **what happened** and **what exactly is broken or not working**? (e.g., screen cracked, not turning on, water damage, etc.)

Once we have this information, we can better advise you on the next steps, which may include troubleshooting, repair options, or exploring warranty coverage.

In the meantime, you can also visit our support page for common issues and warranty information here: [Link to Your Company's Support/Warranty Page]

We are committed to helping you get this resolved as quickly as possible. Please reply to this email with the details requested, or if you prefer to speak with someone directly, you can contact our support team at [Your Phone Number] or start a live chat on our website at [Link to Live Chat].

Thank you for your patience as we work to assist you.

Sincerely,

The [Your Company Name] Support Team
